# Chief Technology Officer

Own technology strategy and engineering execution for a growing software company.

## Required

- Executive engineering leadership and organisational design
- Product and platform architecture strategy
- Building and mentoring engineering teams
- Security governance, technical risk and operational resilience
- Commercial judgement, prioritisation and stakeholder communication
- Cloud-native architecture and modernising legacy systems

## Preferred

- Hands-on software engineering credibility
- AI and data strategy
- Technical due diligence and scaling through rapid growth
